title: UCOS Contract — Operation Meta-Schema
description: Meta-schema for a single contract operation at the boundary level. Verb semantics + path template + intent are catalog-verbatim; 'kind' is a DERIVED normalization of the catalog's stated verb semantics. Request/response/error are OPTIONAL references (deferred field-level schemas), never invented. Transport-neutral, implementation-neutral.

operationId.description: OPTIONAL stable canonical operation name. Absent in the v1 catalog inventory; when absent a generator MUST derive it deterministically (documented) rather than inventing arbitrary names.

verbSemantics.description: Catalog verb denoting operation SEMANTICS (safe/unsafe/idempotent), NOT a chosen transport verb.

path.description: Catalog-verbatim path template. Path/query parameters (e.g. {scope}, {key}, {class}, {context}, {id}, ?type=) are surfaced but their field-level TYPES are deferred.

kind.description: DERIVED field: deterministic normalization of verbSemantics per the catalog's verb-semantics reading note (GET -> safe-read; PUT -> unsafe-idempotent; POST -> unsafe-create; PATCH -> unsafe-idempotent; DELETE -> unsafe-idempotent). Provenance = derived, not verbatim.

parameters.description: OPTIONAL. Structured path/query parameters. Absent in v1 catalog inventory (types deferred to Prompt 05/08).

request.description: OPTIONAL request contract. Deferred field-level schema represented via placeholder.

responses.description: OPTIONAL response contracts. Absent when the catalog defines no field-level response schema.

errors.description: OPTIONAL error model. The catalog defines none for API-018/027; represented as declared:false.

idempotency.description: OPTIONAL idempotency obligation. Absent for API-018/027 operations in the catalog.

pagination.description: OPTIONAL cursor-pagination obligation for read collections. Declared generically by the catalog; concrete parameters deferred.

$comment: Additive evolution only. 'operationId', 'parameters', 'request', 'responses', 'errors', 'idempotency', 'pagination' are OPTIONAL so v1 catalog inventories validate unchanged. No implementation-specific fields.

schemaRef.description: A reference to a SchemaModel node (see SchemaModel.ts). Does NOT inline a field-level schema; points to one once defined by the data architecture.

ref.description: Opaque reference token to a canonical schema node (e.g. a data-contract payload family).
